description: Na₂Mg(SbO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent SbO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one SbO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-32°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted SbO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent SbO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-32°. All Sb-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids.
